scope: Only Dnmt3a, Kmt2a, Kdm2b single-gene zygotic KO E8.5 and GSE122187 WT E8.5, plus WT-only state kernels across E6.5-E8.5; no other task reuse
license_basis: NCBI GEO imposes no restrictions on data use/distribution; author-deposited measurements and metadata show no contrary data-specific restriction. No claim of CC licensing is made. Article academic-manuscript terms and GPL3 code license are not used to license the numerical dataset. Retain attribution, accession IDs and source processing disclosure.

phenotype_review.Dnmt3a: Single Dnmt3a KO has postnatal viability phenotype with neuronal abnormalities; primary study E8.5 chromatin perturbation, not conditional cardiac Gata4/Gata6 dosage or beta-catenin deletion. No identified comparable cardiac phenocopy in selected context.
phenotype_review.Kmt2a: Primary study explicitly reports normal advancement through E8.5 (Results: Epigenetic deregulation at E6.5); trithorax methyltransferase perturbation, not same target allele or identified cardiac phenocopy.
phenotype_review.Kdm2b: Primary study reports production of mature cell types and insufficient deregulation to substantially alter early embryo patterning; distinct from severe Eed/Rnf2 arrest. Shared developmental regulation is not itself phenocopy.
phenotype_review.WT: Explicit WT controls from original same-laboratory gastrulation compendium used by study. E8.5 restriction for Task 2 is not applied to Task 3; no Gata4/beta-catenin KO.

unselected: All other conditions outside permit, without declaring them prohibited. Eed/Rnf2/L3mbtl2 severe arrest deferred for separate review.
uses: within-state response contrasts against source WT
limitations: Zygotic whole-embryo perturbation differs from mesoderm-lineage conditional deletion
Libraries a/b are technical cell partitions, not independent biological replicates; require SNP embryo assignments for proper embryo validation
WT kernel stage states do not establish causal perturbation signs
training_permission: Only integrity-verified completed files subsequently hash-bound in TASK_DATA_PERMIT.json
